About me
☕️📷🪴🎧

I start on the floor, not in Figma.

I'm Aniket Sunil Pawar, a product specialist who likes the software nobody demos — store floors, booking funnels, back offices. Nobody chooses these tools, which is exactly why they're usually terrible and exactly why fixing them feels good.

I spend the first weeks watching people work, argue for a better problem than the one I was handed, and only then open Figma. Then I sweat the unglamorous parts: empty states, error copy, naming things well, and a system engineers actually want to use.

Off the clock: long walks, slow cooking, and photographing badly-designed signage to send to friends who did not ask.
